verdict.rationale: Lever's recruitment analytics product page claims customizable dashboards tracking metrics leaders care about, trend/rolling-average forecasting, and benchmarking against 26,000 talent teams, which plausibly covers stage conversion, time-to-hire, and source effectiveness by role/team. However, there is no explicit mention of offer-accept rate tracking or per-role/per-team breakdown specifics, and all evidence is vendor marketing copy with no independent/hands-on corroboration of accuracy or granularity. Missing for 10: explicit offer-accept-rate metric documentation, per-role/team filtering specifics, and independent verification of dashboard accuracy.
